hints.title: Horner Rule Evaluation
hints.text: Traverse the linked list from head to tail while shifting the accumulated value left by one bit.

hints.title: Incorporate Current Bit
hints.text: At each node, multiply the accumulated total by two and add node value.

hints.title: Single Pass Traversal
hints.text: Initialize ans = 0; while node is not empty, ans = (ans << 1) | node.val, then advance node.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in linked list
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting to an intermediate string and re-parsing takes unnecessary allocation and passes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitwise shift left and bitwise OR operates directly in constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate performs stream-like bit accumulation without storing all digits.
complexity.notes: Nodes are at most 30, fitting comfortably in standard 32-bit integers.
